2026 Season Snapshot

The DC Metro Golfweek Amateur will begin it's 17th year providing competitive golf in the Northern Virginia, Maryland and Lower Pennsylvania Area.  If you enjoy weekend golf at some of the finest local courses, if you enjoy competitive stroke-play golf, if you want to improve your game by playing under tournament conditions like the pros, and if you like the feeling of winning, collecting prizes and trophies, join the tour and enjoy all of these benefits. All tournaments are played by USGA rules and handicaps are tracked on each player to ensure the integrity of each flight.

ON Deck

The DC Metro Battlefield Open @ Stonewall Golf Club

15601 Turtle Point Drive, Gainesville, Virginia 20155

Our journey continues at the award-winning Stonewall Golf Club, overlooking the historic Manassas National Battlefield. With scenic lake views, immaculate fairways, and a layout that demands smart shot-making, Stonewall provides one of the premier golf experiences in the region while honoring the rich history surrounding it.

These tournaments are more than just another round of golf—they're an opportunity to compete on championship-caliber courses, experience America's history firsthand, and create lasting memories with your fellow Tour members.
